notes.title: December Update - v1.3.0
notes.content:
Hello passengers,

For this month's update, we've added support for a couple of the most popular languages on Steam. We also fixed a few annoying bugs, especially ones that bricked your in-game phone. Finally, we've got some new content that's sure to please anyone who likes to get a little meta: two exclusive episodes of the Eggplant podcast, one of them about Airplane Mode itself (think of it as our way of doing a developer commentary).

Added:
- [New Podcast] Eggplant: The Secret Lives of Games
- Simplified Chinese localization
- Russian localization

Fixes:
- Disabled pull-down menu during Photo editing
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: Halloween Weekend Update - v1.1
notes.content:
Hi folks, we've released an update to fix some issues with our landing gear. We also pushed an update to the in-game phones of flyers with non-standard screen resolutions. We also added a little something spooky from our friends at AMC TV. As always, please let us know if you've got any questions or you encounter any new issues with your service.

Added:
- The Walking Dead: Lil' Walkie beta (virtual pet app for the in-game phone)
- Opt-in error reporting added to the Settings menu

Fixes:
- Addressed aircraft skid after landing
- Aligned clickable area on some resolutions
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: Major bug fixes in v1.03
notes.content:
We’ve released an update to address all the known memory and graphics issues in Airplane Mode. This update should be applied automatically the next time you restart Steam. If you encounter any new issues, please let us know in the comments.

The 1.03 update includes:

Fixes
- Memory leak causing crashes on some Windows machines has been resolved
- Broken engine audio loop has been fixed
- Phone clock display time has been fixed
- Channel 9 no longer breaks the entertainment system
- Some instances of text appearing incorrectly have been addressed
- Tweaks made to the sleep transition
- Other minor quality of life changes

Known Issue
- Clickable UI areas shifting at some resolutions (when not set to 1080 or 720)

notes.title: Update from the Devs
notes.content:
Hey, It's Hosni again.
Here's an update: We've identified the memory leak issue as being a bug between our engine's video player and windows media player (which apparently only affects a portion of PCs).
We've upgraded to a newer version of the engine and that seems to have fixed the memory leak issue but we're still running tests to make sure that noting else was affected. 

The next step is we want to widen our tests. If you believe you've been affected by this memory leak bug and are willing to help us test, please  email me at  [i]apmode.main@gmail.com[/i]  and I will set you up with a test build. 

If all goes well with these tests, we can have the patch live soon afterwards. Hopefully no more than a couple of days.  

I will continue to keep you updated and, once again, I sincerely apologize if you have been unable to play the game due to these issues. 

-Hosni
